answer: We buy cars that don't run. Some stores will tow your car to the store for free, and your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing. Cars that don't run can't use home pickup. A specialist confirms the offer after inspecting the car at the store, and we still don't accept flood-damaged cars. You don't need a payoff letter, because Meridian Auto Loans is in our e-payoff network. We confirm the payoff directly with Meridian the same day at your appointment, so just bring your loan account number.
